# Vocabulary.com

> > An interactive English learning platform combining a comprehensive dictionary with adaptive word games and educational tools for vocabulary building.

Vocabulary.com offers personalized vocabulary learning through its intelligent dictionary, gamified activities like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam, and resources designed for both individual learners and classroom environments. The platform uses adaptive learning technology to help users master English words through context and practice.
